title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Portable Provenance Transport and Automatic Authority Downgrade Extension

new_primitives.CLAIM_ID: Stable identity for the signed/attested semantic claim.
new_primitives.CLAIM_CANONICALIZATION_PROFILE: Exact profile used before calculating CLAIM_DIGEST.
new_primitives.PORTABLE_PROVENANCE_ENVELOPE: Machine-readable binding of claim, host lineage, output class, authority context and attestation.
new_primitives.RECEIPT_LOCATOR: Portable identifier used to retrieve a receipt; never sufficient without revalidation.
new_primitives.DETACHED_CONTENT_STATUS: Mandatory downgrade applied when verified content is separated from its provenance binding.

transport_rule: Authority and provenance are not inherited from visual appearance. Every receiving context revalidates the portable envelope under its accepted verifier profile and current trust roots.
portable_pipeline: SOURCE_COMMIT -> CANONICAL_CLAIM -> CLAIM_DIGEST -> PROVENANCE_ENVELOPE -> TRANSPORT -> RECEIVER_REVALIDATION -> TRUSTED_PRESENTATION
authority_rule: A portable provenance envelope may prove origin and original authority context, but current executable authority must also pass current epoch, revocation, scope and effect-gate checks.
anti_spoof_rule: A receiving UI may display VERIFIED only after successful local verification; imported text cannot carry a trusted badge by styling or wording.
verification_requirements: copy authoritative text without receipt and confirm downgrade to UNVERIFIED
transport exact claim plus envelope and reverify digest
transport file plus sidecar and reject mismatched content digest
show screenshot without receipt remains display evidence only
resolve locator from screenshot and verify only the underlying canonical claim
reject stale or revoked authority even when origin receipt was valid
canonical_lines: Portable provenance is a reverifiable relation, not a visual decoration.
Detached content loses verified authority until the relation is reconstructed and checked.
A receipt may travel; trust is recomputed at the destination.
